status: Local implementation verified; CI and production verification follow publication.
story: Four persistent agent lanes and work A-J. E/F commits during A/B validation; G/H drafts start during E/F validation. All three deployments retain approval and the default recheck. Four final drafts remain unsubmitted.

media.codec: H.264 constrained baseline, yuv420p, BT.709, fast-start

visual_iterations.finding: Anonymous agents disappeared when work left. The next batch looked like the old work. Overlap appeared too late.
visual_iterations.change: Keep four numbered agent lanes visible. Give work A-J stable letters. Start E/F at 3.8 seconds during A/B validation. Retain applied changes.

visual_iterations.finding: A second idle interval weakened the continuing-work story.
visual_iterations.change: Capture real G/H edits during E/F validation and show those drafts while checks run.

visual_iterations.finding: The replay crossfade double-exposed task labels. The repair path crowded the check heading.
visual_iterations.change: Switch labels once and fade work cards sequentially. Keep agent identities visible. Move the repair path into the gap.

limitations: Physical iOS and Android devices were not tested. Narrow desktop viewports verify layout only.
The capture scripts agent-authored changes and approvals; it does not launch an AI service. Four displayed agent roles are illustrative.
Two fixture gate barriers make overlap deterministic. Timing is condensed and is not a speed claim.
The animation repeats one recorded window. G-J are drafts, not submitted or validated work.
